notes: Proof House and its first collection ARTIFACTS: 256 encrypted generative pieces (255 editions and THE SOURCE). No fungible token or pool; the only tokens are ERC-721 NFTs minted only when a piece is bought. IMD, the existing ERC-20 at 0x44a1Cd38474FB1748400E7DEb5F8D786ccE3F89A, is accepted as payment for the house's plain SVG collections. The brief named four contracts; ArtifactsFactory is split into factory, sale, auction and escrow so every runtime stays under EIP-170 (largest ArtifactsPiece at 12,395 bytes). Constructors take only static values, $owner and earlier contracts and call no other contract. ArtStorage($owner): SSTORE2 chunk storage for plain SVG pieces, writable only by ArtHouse after the owner's one-time setHouse. ArtHouse($owner, ArtStorage, IMD): the house ledger (artists with changeable payout, brokers, approved sale modules, per-collection splits defaulting to broker 15% / house 15% / artist 70% with rounding to the house, per-currency ETH and IMD balances withdrawn by each party, house balance paid to the current owner), plain SVG collections as EIP-1167 clones of the ArtCollection implementation its constructor deploys, 7.5% ERC-2981 royalty to the artist payout, and the submission registry. ArtifactsPiece(): locked EIP-1167 implementation of a one-token ERC-721 + ERC-2981 piece (ARTIFACTS #NNN, ARTIFACTS · THE SOURCE). ArtifactsFactory($owner, ArtHouse, ArtifactsPiece): the ARTIFACTS registry of public traits, SSTORE2 ciphertext and content-key commitments locked forever by the curator, edition assignments, viewing keys, wrapped keys, claims that clone ArtifactsPiece, and the on-chain seal tokenURI. ArtifactsSale($owner, ArtHouse, ArtifactsFactory): edition sale at one curator-set ETH price through the ledger with brokers, Chainlink VRF v2.5 assignment (coordinator, key hash and subscription set once by the owner), no edition assigned twice or skipped. ArtifactsAuction($owner, ArtHouse, ArtifactsFactory): single-lot ETH auction for THE SOURCE with reserve, 5% minimum raise, 10-minute anti-snipe extension and pull refunds. ArtifactsEscrow(ArtHouse, ArtifactsFactory): keyed resale escrow with 72-hour release and buyer cancel until the key is posted; it has no owner or administrative power. $owner is the curator on every owned contract: two-step ownership, renounceOwnership disabled, ETH sent by call, no upgradeability, no mint that bypasses payment. After launch the owner wires the system: ArtStorage.setHouse, ArtHouse.approveArtist / createModuleCollection / approveModule for the four ARTIFACTS modules, ArtifactsFactory.setModules, ArtifactsSale.configureVRF, setPiece x256 and lock, then setPrice / openSale and the auction configure.
